race.description: Jarrod Arentz Electric/ Solar Solutions Mdn Plate
race.comment: Tough one to sort out with not a lot of compelling formlines. NUMBERSNEVERSEEN (4) showed good early speed and led into the straight before fading to finish ninth, beaten 5.5 lengths, over 2000m at Mildura. Should be tough to rein in. JULEP (10) ran below expectations last time at Ballarat Synthetic, finishing sixth and beaten 10 lengths starting at $7.50. This is a nice drop in grade so she is a major player. QUEENS OF VINO (11) did little and finished 14 lengths from the winner in seventh over 1600m at Pakenham Synthetic last start, a less impressive effort than her sixth at Pakenham Synthetic the run before. Beautifully placed and gets the chance to play a pivotal role. LA REEL DEAL (3) turned in a moderate effort last start when 9 lengths from the winner in 10th over 1700m at Geelong at the second run back from a spell. No surprise to see him in the mix in this company. ZHOU SHU (7) will be better for the two runs back and gets out to 1600m for the first time.
